title: Action recommendation rules
description: A rules table, pipeline/layers/<table>.rules.json, that a vector layer names in LAYER_RULES. The pipeline evaluates every action's condition per feature at build time and writes the results as tile attributes: action_<id> (1 or 0), action_<id>_reason (the title and reason, only when recommended) and actions_<type>_count (per action type). ADR 0011; docs/design/02_data_layers_and_popups.md.

$schema.description: Optional, for editors: the path to this schema.

description.description: What the table is and where its rules come from.

types.description: The action types. Each gets a count attribute, actions_<id>_count, even with no actions yet.

actions.description: The actions, each recommended for a feature when its condition is true. A condition that is false or null (a missing value) does not recommend the action.

title.description: The action, for example "Area-based conservation - 30x30 goals".

condition.description: When the action is recommended: an expression on the layer's attributes (after LAYER_FIELDS renames) and calculated fields, for example "protected_pcnt < 30". The expression language is in docs/design/02_data_layers_and_popups.md (Calculated fields and action rules).

reason.description: Why, after the title in action_<id>_reason, for example "recommended because current protection is less than 30%".

source.description: Optional: where the rule comes from (for people; not tiled).

id.description: Lower case letters, digits and _, starting with a letter; part of attribute names.
